{{Quote|However, the best (and cheapest) way to sample the authentic flavors of Lianna is to eat on the street&mdash;fish sticks baked in choya and lill and served on a plastic stick, Bubble Bowls of VegeParsine, fresh choya bread and Dalkash ale.|''How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day'' lists Liann street food|<ref name="MTL" />}}
A '''Bubble Bowl''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] container used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lianna/Legends|Lianna]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The dish [[Vegeparsine|VegeParsine]] could be purchased in Bubble Bowls on the streets of the [[Lola Curich Starport|starport]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Lola Curich]] on Lianna. According to the travel guide ''[[How to Do the Allied Tion on 25 Credits a Day]]'', Bubble Bowls of VegeParsine were a cheap way to effectively sample Liann cuisine, as were other street foods and beverages such as [[choya bread]], [[Dalkash ale]], and [[fish stick]]s made with [[lill]] and choya.<ref name="MTL" />

==Behind the scenes==
Bubble Bowls were first mentioned in ''[[Mission to Lianna]]'', an adventure written by [[Joanne E. Wyrick]] and released in [[1992]] for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="MTL" />
